title: jacobaeastrum lineare
intro: Jacobaeastrum lineare, commonly known as Jacobaea, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. Bioactive constituents of Jacobaea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
